$comment: Fact-flow sidecar (Posudek 17): which namespace keys (contracts/facts.v1.json) this module's capabilities consume and produce. A sidecar on purpose — module-descriptor.v1.schema.json is frozen. Keys only, never values; capability set must equal descriptor.json (FACT-004). Consumed keys mirror the document-stamped template (mail-intake: documentType from validate, artifactId from stamp); other templates will declare their own needs when they exist.
